project_tagging_convention.content: Standard convention: every email belonging to an active named project gets a label of the form 'Proj/<Name>' (e.g., 'Proj/Alpha'). Rule: apply only to threads materially about the deal (pricing, contracts, scoping, internal planning); do NOT tag purely social/scheduling threads. Existing functional labels (Pricing, Contracts, Internal) are kept, not replaced. The 'Proj/Alpha' label already exists in the workspace.
